title: Accept CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN so the CLI can run on a Claude Pro/Max plan
description: Follow-up from loreweaver-qyj research (docs/agent-sdk-auth.md). The Claude Agent SDK supports subscription auth via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (from 'claude setup-token'), but Loreweaver's loadConfig hard-requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and the CLI injects that key through the AgentSdkModelClient auth seam. Per Claude Code's credential precedence, an injected ANTHROPIC_API_KEY also overrides any subscription token. To support Pro/Max: loadConfig should accept CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN as an alternative to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and buildPlayDeps must inject whichever credential is in use (NOT ANTHROPIC_API_KEY when the OAuth token is selected). The AgentSdkAuthSource seam added in loreweaver-lus already supports arbitrary env injection, so this is a config-layer change only.
acceptance_criteria: loadConfig accepts a Pro/Max OAuth token as an alternative to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the CLI injects the selected credential through the auth seam without injecting an API key that would shadow the token; docs/README updated; tests cover OAuth-token config resolution.
